items.title: Cedar Walton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Dianne Reeves uncle, Charlie Burrell, was the bassist in that group... I said, 'Please give him my regards.'

ctx.x: Do you remember what you played?

Uh, Dancing on the Ceiling. Uh, I remember we played things in C which puts it in uh, A-natural for, for alto, and another one uh, in C, but I can't remember exactly what it was. Diane Reeves is, is, is a bit of a trivia on that. Dianne Reeves uncle, Charlie Burrell, was the bassist in that group, and he also played with the Denver Symphony. He played very good jazz bass. He still does, too. I mean, this amazing coincidence, I think, 'cause when I met uh, Dianne, she told me that she was the niece of Charlie…
What was it, stay with Bird further, what impression did his playing have on you?
